articles.original_title: Security Council LIVE: Can conflict resolution keep pace as AI and drones reshape war?
articles.original_summary: When the UN was founded in 1945, computers, the internet and satellites were the stuff of science fiction. Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is already assisting in targeting, drones are reshaping warfare and disinformation is spreading in unprecedented ways, fuelling record levels of conflict. The Security Council on Tuesday is weighing these changes, with UN chief António Guterres telling ambassadors, “killer robots must have no place in our future.”

articles.original_title: Canada invests in new mineral exploration capabilities through the Canadian Digital Core Library
articles.original_summary: Today, Claude Guay, Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, announced nearly $3 million in funding for the Northwest Territories to scan and digitize the territory’s drill core collections under the Canadian Digital Core Library (CDCL). He also highlighted that in Manitoba, scanning of the Manitoba Geological Survey drill core began on October 19, 2026, at the Midland Sample and Core Library in Winnipeg.

content.headline: Canada invests in new mineral exploration capabilities through the Canadian Digital Core Library
content.summary: Today, Claude Guay, Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, announced nearly $3 million in funding for the Northwest Territories to scan and digitize the territory’s drill core collections under the Canadian Digital Core Library (CDCL). He also highlighted that in Manitoba, scanning of the Manitoba Geological Survey drill core began on October 19, 2026, at the Midland Sample and Core Library in Winnipeg.

publication.telegram:
Canada invests in new mineral exploration capabilities through the Canadian Digital Core Library

Today, Claude Guay, Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, announced nearly $3 million in funding for the Northwest Territories to scan and digitize the territory’s drill core collections under the Canadian Digital Core Library (CDCL). He also highlighted that in Manitoba, scanning of the Manitoba Geological Survey drill core began on October 19, 2026, at the Midland Sample and Core Library in Winnipeg.

Verification: SINGLE_SOURCE

Sources: canada_news

website.headline: Canada invests in new mineral exploration capabilities through the Canadian Digital Core Library
website.summary: Today, Claude Guay, Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, announced nearly $3 million in funding for the Northwest Territories to scan and digitize the territory’s drill core collections under the Canadian Digital Core Library (CDCL). He also highlighted that in Manitoba, scanning of the Manitoba Geological Survey drill core began on October 19, 2026, at the Midland Sample and Core Library in Winnipeg.
website.body: Today, Claude Guay, Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, announced nearly $3 million in funding for the Northwest Territories to scan and digitize the territory’s drill core collections under the Canadian Digital Core Library (CDCL). He also highlighted that in Manitoba, scanning of the Manitoba Geological Survey drill core began on October 19, 2026, at the Midland Sample and Core Library in Winnipeg.

articles.original_title: Joint statement by the Minister of Industry of Canada and the Minister responsible for Canada Economic Development for Quebec Regions, and the Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation of South Africa on advancing bilateral cooperation in science, technology, and innovation
